units.source_en: In his eyes, Ieyasu was unfathomable; no one present could approach even a fraction of the depth of his cunning.
units.source_zh: 在他看来，家康深不可测，其城府之深，在座众人根本无法及其万一。

paragraphs.source_zh: 一旦明白了这个道理，黑田、浅野和堀尾诸人也一脸释然。只有细川忠兴面带微笑，却并不附和。他本性多疑，说不定正自盘算家康。在他看来，家康深不可测，其城府之深，在座众人根本无法及其万一。

paragraphs.source_en: Murakoshi Mōsuke’s arrival transformed the atmosphere in Kiyosu Castle. The commanders, who until then had been deeply anxious over Ieyasu’s continued failure to dispatch his forces, fully recovered their vigor. They immediately began devising how to attack the Western Army, and in an instant they became true vanguards. All this brought immense relief to Ii Naomasa and Honda Tadakatsu, who had gone ahead as army inspectors only to find themselves caught between the commanders and Ieyasu in an impossible position.

paragraphs.source_en: “Every man has his own particular strength.” After leaving the great hall and arranging for Murakoshi Mōsuke to rest in another room, Ii Naomasa could not help remarking, “If Murakoshi had followed our wishes and said that His Lordship had caught a cold, there is no telling how great an uproar it might have caused.”

paragraphs.source_en: Honda Tadakatsu could not help chuckling.

paragraphs.source_en: “Lord Honda, why are you laughing?”

paragraphs.source_en: “His Lordship is remarkably composed.” Naomasa said, “In former days, Takeda Shingen’s banners bore the words ‘Wind, Forest, Fire, and Mountain.’ His Lordship truly embodies ‘quiet as a forest.’”

paragraphs.source_en: Ii Naomasa shook his head slightly. “How could I possibly fathom His Lordship’s thoughts? His Lordship plans deeply and looks far ahead. How could ordinary men such as we understand him?”
